body: Rolling Loud: The Movie is officially hitting theaters on October 2, 2026 The comedy follows Owen Wilson’s overprotective dad as he takes his 13-year-old hip-hop-obsessed son to Rolling Loud, where he struggles to understand the world his son is into. Things get even funnier when he takes the artists’ names literally, mistaking Ski Mask the Slump God for a serial k*ller and Megan Thee Stallion @theestallion for an actual horse. rollingloud rap hiphop.
